title: Ghostline
summary: Pay-per-call channels for AI agents using cumulative off-chain vouchers and one settlement. November 14 source review: the current v0.5.0 README and November 13 creator posts identify Ootle mainnet. Veil displays GhostlineChannel template ae13cead…3cef9c at epoch 38576 with new, settle and settle_batch functions. Settlement pays the service, returns payer change and directs a 1% protocol fee to the treasury. The CLI/MCP route requires Linux x86-64 and a separately configured wallet; the archived October Esmeralda demo targets a retired template. The service sees requests, vouchers and deposit limits. Fees, timing, open/close links and the three-output settlement shape remain public; call counts come from service ledgers rather than chain proof. The batch coordinator is an SDK prototype, not coordinator-private or demonstrated on mainnet. MIT source. The November 14 recording is a README walkthrough, with no CLI, wallet or payment execution; prior testnet footage and receipts remain in maintenance history.
cardSummary: Let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative off-chain vouchers and a single channel settlement.
